thread:
maya: Heads-up — onboarding aurora-lite-12b (int4) on canary. Seeing intermittent OOMs when requests use long generations (>512). Not steady, looks correlated with batch size and kv cache churn.

zach: Can you paste the failure log? also which kernel/version?

maya: kernel: inference-rt v2.3.1, runtime-build: gpu-2026-03. Log snippet: ```
E OOM at alloc_page: slab_jitter=0.62
E kv_cache: eviction triggered, evicting 1 slots
E alloc_tensor: failed to allocate 312MB for new_tokens buffer
E trace: batch_id=9832, seq_len=640, max_new=1024
```

ida: fwiw we saw similar slab_jitter on argo13b last month. Default slot_reserve was 0.05; we bumped to 0.12 and it improved.

ben: Quick thought: the model's tokenization produces long prefix arrays for some customers (system messages + examples). Could be causing seq_len spikes. Any eval sets showing >512 often?

maya: Yes, our internal convo-bench had 8% requests >512 for the docs summarization workload. Canary traffic matches that distribution.

zach: Repro plan: (1) reproduce on local canary with mix of short+long requests (2) try slot_reserve=0.14 and soft-evict=true (3) lower default max_new_tokens to 256 for this model on hosted canary.

ida: Also add a KV-prefetch grace window to avoid aggressive prefetch when seq_len jumps. That helped on argo.

ben: Sounds good. One more: enable "small_batch_fallback" so large max_new_tokens requests get isolated to single-si threads when memory tight. Less throughput but prevents cluster-wide OOM ripple.

maya: I'll run step 1+2 now. Pushing canary config patch: ```yaml
model: aurora-lite-12b-int4
defaults:
  max_new_tokens: 256
  slot_reserve: 0.14
  soft_evict: true
  small_batch_fallback: true
  kv_prefetch_grace_ms: 80
```

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary config for aurora-lite-12b-int4 queued (change set 5472). Will apply to canary pool in ~3min.

maya: Applying synthetic load now (mix: 80% <128, 12% 128-512, 8% >512).

zach: If that stabilizes, we should also update the model onboarding checklist: - run convo-bench distribution checks - set conservative max_new default - run slab_jitter diagnostic tool.

maya: First 10m after patch: no OOMs so far, eviction rate dropped ~70%, slab_jitter metric down to 0.18. Still seeing occasional slow gens (+120ms) on 512+ but not catastrophic.

ida: Nice. Can you capture a couple of profiles and add to the model ticket? Would be good for later quant rollout docs.

maya: Yep, uploading CPU/GPU profiles + canary logs to the ticket. Proposal: ship with conservative defaults (max_new_tokens=256, slot_reserve=0.12) and add an opt-in for higher max_new with "isolation=true" so customers can request it.

ben: Agreed. Also add a note in the release notes about quality tradeoff for int4 on long-horizon tasks. Some customers might need int8.

maya: Will do. Thanks all :thumbsup:

zach: Great triage, thanks maya + ida. We'll monitor for 24h and then schedule the rollout to prod default if clean.

infra-bot: monitor-bot: alerting rule updated: aurora-lite-12b slab_jitter > 0.4 -> pg @eng-ml.
